summary: Jackson County ODF lookout: a 1950 L-4 tower, a 1973 replacement cab, staffed until 2016 and camera-watched since 2017. Sources disagree on height and early history.

facts.design: ODF flattop live-in cab with catwalk on a treated timber tower (1973 replacement); the 1950 original was an L-4 on a pole tower

access.note: Cherylhill lists the site as legally accessible; the directory says this does not mean access to the lookout itself. No source says the cab is open to visitors.

visit.trail_note: NHLR 2016 visit report: no Register sign posted and directions to the tower are not signed

events.note: FireLookout.com: 100-foot observation tower; not corroborated by the other sources read
First lookout in service per NHLR: L-4 cab on a 20-foot pole tower. FireLookout.com also gives 1950. Weebly reports a December 1949 announcement of the tower.
June 1959 item says a named lookout manned the tower that morning
Break-in; fire extinguisher and LPG light stolen
New cab and tower under an agreement with Gene Ash for $1000 in state-furnished materials. Weebly gives a 24-foot tower; NHLR and FireLookout.com give 20 feet.

Register-Guard profile dated August 27, 1995 (quoted on the Weebly page): a fire spotter on the tower reported a smoke column in the Sardine Creek drainage after a lightning storm the month before and called in several grass fires. No fire is named.
Registered March 31, 2003 (Register registry numbers US 501, OR 93)
Last year of active service per the October 2016 Register visit report
Cameras installed on the tower; no longer staffed

corrections.proposed: ODF flattop live-in cab with catwalk on a treated timber tower (1973); the 1950 original was an L-4 on a pole tower
corrections.why: The Register says the L-4 was the 1950 structure, replaced in 1973 by the current cab. The brief's design describes the first tower, not the standing one.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Weebly says the 1973 tower is 24 feet (7.3 m), which is the value kept in facts. The Register and FireLookout.com say 20 feet (6.1 m). The sources are not reconciled.

FireLookout.com dates a 100-foot observation tower to 1934. The Register dates the first service to 1950 and Weebly reports a 1949 announcement. The 1934 structure is kept as a single-source claim, not as settled fact.
FireLookout.com says staffed every summer. The Register's 2016 visit report says it has not been staffed since 2016 and has been camera-watched since 2017. The dated Register report is used.
The Register gives 4,626 ft (1,410 m). FireLookout.com and Cherylhill give 4,658 ft. The record's 1410 m is the Register figure.

notes_for_editor: Core facts agree across sources: ODF-run, Jackson County, 1973 cab, unmanned since 2016 season, cameras since 2017. Early history conflicts: 1934 vs 1949-50 start, and 20 vs 24 feet. The brief's height_m 7.3 m is kept because it matches only the Weebly 24-foot figure. No fire is named. A 1995 Register-Guard profile quoted on the Weebly page reports a fire spotter's smoke sighting and grass fires called in (event 1995). A Former Fire Lookout Sites register page titled 'Round Top Lookout Site' appeared in a search snippet only (not read, not cited): it describes a 1933 crow's nest, a 1946 35-foot L-4 abandoned 1965 and removed 1970. It may be a different chronology for this peak. Worth a fetch and a county check before any edit. Access level 'public' refers to the site only; no source says the cab can be climbed.
